description: What is a robot? Are robots our friends? Does the term “friend” even apply? So begins this week’s episode of Team Human with cyborg anthropologist Amber Case . Amber and Douglas look at how algorithmically programmed systems of automation and control might just be turning us into the robots. Case’s recent book, Calm Technology Design For the Next Generation of Devices proposes another way. How might we flip the script on systems that compress and atomize our every move? How might we use our tech…
classificationReason: Substantially discusses robots, automation, algorithmic systems, and how technology shapes human behavior, though it is primarily sociotechnical rather than engineering-focused.
qualityReason: An original interview with a named expert and a developed conceptual discussion.
